summary: Temporary restricted area for drones only at Springholm, within 1 nautical mile and up to 1700 feet above sea level, flying forbidden without police permission.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED FOR UAS ONLY (SPRINGHOLM)
WI 1NM RADIUS OF 550038N 0035222W. PILOTS ARE FORBIDDEN TO FLY
UAS WI THE DESIGNATED AREA WITHOUT THE PERMISSION OF POLICE
SCOTLAND CTC 07989 355901, OR BTN 0800-1600 CTC 07765 749919. 
INCIDENT NUMBER PS-20261122-2269 REFERS. RESTRICTION OF FLYING 
REGULATIONS MADE UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF AIR NAV ORDER 2016. 
AR-2026-11155/01.
